text:
emily-hiring: Hey people-ops, need help. Internal transfer promotion (Infra -> Platform) approved effective 2026-03-01 but payroll already ran. Can we do a retro compband uplift and sort benefits proration?

lucy-peopleops: Thanks — quick Qs: what was old band and new band, and manager sign-off exists?

emily-hiring: Band S2 -> S3. Base went from $135k -> $155k. Hiring manager (@mike-ops) signed the approval doc yesterday: https://rdw/doc/transfer-123 (pdf).

simon-finance: Do we have a cost center and headcount funding code? Need to know whether we charge current org or receiving org for backpay.

emily-hiring: Fund on receiving org (Platform) CC: PL-3402, manager confirmed. Manager asked for backpay to include difference for March pay period + adjust YTD tax.

payroll-bot: ⚠️ Payroll cutoff missed for 2026-03 payroll batch. Off-cycle required. Submit off-cycle request with reason, gross delta, tax withholding instructions. Use template: `payroll-offcycle-request`

lucy-peopleops: If we do off-cycle, benefits enrollment changes are tricky — medical coverage effective dates can only be backdated to first of month in our system. For 3/1 change we can do medical effective 3/1 only if benefits team approves retro enrollment paperwork.

ben-legal: Also flag equity/vesting implications. If promotion changes grant terms or acceleration, need manager signed attestation. Otherwise compband uplift is payroll-only.

emily-hiring: Manager signed attestation attached in doc. Can we do split approach: pay backpay in off-cycle for March delta, and set benefits effective 4/1 if legal/benefits prefer? Manager prefers earliest health coverage but ok with 4/1 if retro paperwork blocks it.

simon-finance: That split is fine. We'll run off-cycle backpay with tax withholding per employee's bracket. Please confirm gross delta and net estimate. Finance needs ledger id before we process.

lucy-peopleops: Emily, fill this snippet and cc payrollops: ```
RequestType: Off-cycle backpay
Employee: <name>
EmpID: 44672
OldBase: 135000
NewBase: 155000
GrossDelta(Mar): 1666.67
BenefitChangeRequest: Retro enroll for 3/1 (pending benefits sign-off) OR effective 4/1
ManagerSignOff: link
CostCenter: PL-3402
```

emily-hiring: Filled and sent to payrollops. Also pinging @maria.chen for expedited comp-committee waiver since promotion was internal and payroll missed window.

maria.chen: Reviewed docs. Approve off-cycle backpay for March delta and conditional retro benefits pending benefits team paperwork. Please proceed — escalate any tax questions to finance. :white_check_mark:

payrollops: Received. Creating ticket OC-176380-01. Will schedule off-cycle payroll run on 2026-03-26 COB. Will include YTD tax adjustment. Benefits team to confirm retro enrollment; if denied, we'll set benefits effective 4/1 as discussed.

emily-hiring: Awesome, thanks all. Any docs I should attach besides manager attestation and approval pdf?

payroll-bot: Ticket OC-176380-01 created. Attachments list: manager-attestation.pdf, transfer-123.pdf, payroll-form-filled.pdf. Next update in this thread after payroll run.
